assignments.package_label: שְׁמִירַת הַבְּרִית בִּשְׁתֵּי בְּחִינוֹת וְקְדֻשַּׁת הַזִּוּוּג
assignments.reason: The letter Vav's essential nature in this Torah is tosefot kedusha (additional holiness) = shmirat habrit. The Rebbe explicitly equates vav with the addition that makes kavod complete, and 'wherever vav is said, it adds — the aspect of additional holiness, meaning shmirat habrit.' Its nature IS the covenant/holiness addition, not the kavod it produces. Note: the additions file already identified וא"ו = תוספות קדשה as belonging to this domain.

assignments.package_label: שְׁמִירַת הַבְּרִית בִּשְׁתֵּי בְּחִינוֹת וְקְדֻשַּׁת הַזִּוּוּג
assignments.reason: Tikkun habrit (repairing/guarding the covenant) is by definition the positive practice of brit observance. Its essential nature is covenant sanctity — the same domain as shmirat habrit b'shtei bechinot. It PRODUCES the light that illuminates for teshuva (edge 161), and CAUSES the 39 labors to become Mishkan-work (edge 410), but what it IS is brit observance.

assignments.node_id: על־ידי שמירת הברית בשני הבחינות הנ"ל
assignments.package_label: שְׁמִירַת הַבְּרִית בִּשְׁתֵּי בְּחִינוֹת וְקְדֻשַּׁת הַזִּוּוּג
assignments.reason: Functionally identical to the existing node שמירת הברית בשתי בחינות already in Package 6. This is the same concept — guarding the covenant in its two dimensions — expressed as a causal phrase ('through guarding the brit in both aspects'). Its essential nature is brit observance.

The 'light that illuminates for repentance' is the essential function of the illuminating speech (dibur ha-me'ir). In the Torah's framework, this light IS the dibur — it is the or (light) contained in the vav of kavod, which manifests as illuminating speech. Its nature is illumination/light within the speech domain. It leads TO teshuva but it IS the light of speech.

assignments.node_id: אף־על־פי שהוא עושה הל"ט מלאכות – הם בבחינת מלאכת המשכן
assignments.reason: This node describes the 39 labors becoming Mishkan-work (Tabernacle in its construction). Package 4 already contains both the positive pole (משכן בבנינה, ל"ט אורות) and the negative pole (משכן בחרבנה, ל"ט מלקות) of the Mishkan/39-count structural domain. This node's essential nature is the Mishkan/39 structural framework in its positive expression — the same domain as Package 4's existing nodes.

The attainment of speech. Its essential nature is dibur/speech — the same domain as דבור and דבור המאיר in Package 3. It is PRODUCED by kavod bishleimut (edges 425, 426), but what it IS is the domain of speech itself.

Illuminating words — functionally identical to דבור המאיר already in Package 3. The plural form (דבורים המאירים) refers to the same essential concept: speech that illuminates for repentance. Appears in 5 cause/effect edges as the product of kavod/humility and the producer of teshuva, but its nature IS illuminating speech.

Through each teshuva — the essential nature is repentance itself, the iterative process of returning. This is the same domain as תשובה and תשובת המשקל in Package 7. It causes ascent from level to level (edge 832), but what it IS is the practice of teshuva.

assignments.node_id: הולך ממדרגה למדרגה, עד שיוצא ממדרגה פחותה ובא לתבונות התורה לעמקה
assignments.reason: The process of ascending from level to level until reaching Torah depth. The destination — תבונות התורה לעמקה — defines this node's essential domain. Package 3 already contains תבונות התורה, תבונה, שמים (all aspects of Torah depth). This is the culminating process within that same domain: achieving the depths of Torah understanding.

assignments.node_id: על־ידי האמירות והדבור של איש הישראלי
assignments.reason: Through the words and speech of the Jewish person — this is the human practice of verbalized speech/Torah study. Its essential nature is dibur/speech, the same domain as Package 3. It causes illumination for teshuva (edge 1638), but what it IS is the act of speaking/verbalizing Torah.

assignments.node_id: למקומות שצריך לעשות תשובה יאיר לו הדבור, שיוכל לעשות תשובה
assignments.reason: Speech illuminates the places needing teshuva so one can repent. This compound concept has both speech and teshuva elements, but its essential nature foregrounds the ILLUMINATION function of speech — the dibur illuminating specific locations. The dibur is the active agent here, teshuva is the goal it serves. Belongs with the speech/illumination domain.

Speaking Torah in words — the act of verbalizing Torah study, the foundational practice that generates illuminating speech. Its nature is speech/Torah verbalization. It produces illumination for teshuva (edge 1680) and leads to Torah depth (edge 3077), but what it IS is the practice of verbal Torah engagement.

assignments.node_id: מאיר לו הדבור בכל המקומות שצריך לעשות תשובה
assignments.reason: Speech illuminates all places where one needs teshuva — essentially the same concept as דבור המאיר (illuminating speech) in its active function. The essential nature is the illuminating capacity of speech, squarely in the speech/Torah-depth domain of Package 3.

The depths of Torah understanding — nearly identical to תבונות התורה already in Package 3. This is the fuller form of the same concept: the deep comprehension of Torah that is the ultimate goal of the causal chain. Its essential nature is Torah depth/understanding.

assignments.node_id: שמע ישראל, וברוך שם כבוד מלכותו לעולם ועד
assignments.package_label: שְׁמִירַת הַבְּרִית בִּשְׁתֵּי בְּחִינוֹת וְקְדֻשַּׁת הַזִּוּוּג
assignments.reason: The combined declaration of Shema Yisrael and Baruch Shem — this IS yichuda ila'ah v'yichuda tata'ah expressed in liturgical form. The existing node יחודא עלאה ויחודא תתאה (the compound node) is already in Package 6, representing the synthesis of both unifications. Shema+Baruch Shem is the SAME synthesis in prayer-form. Its essential nature is the combined dual-unification, which is the domain of two-level brit observance.

new_packages.label: כָּבוֹד בִּשְׁלֵמוּת וַעֲנָוָה
new_packages.label_en: Complete Honor of God and Humility
new_packages.reason: These 8 nodes form a coherent thematic cluster around the central concept of kavod bishleimut (completeness of God's honor) achieved through human humility and self-nullification. This is a distinct domain from all existing packages: (1) it is not brit/covenant (Pkg 6) — brit PRODUCES kavod, but kavod is not itself brit; (2) it is not speech (Pkg 3) — kavod PRODUCES speech, but kavod is not itself speech; (3) it is not arrogance (Pkg 5) — kavod bishleimut is the POSITIVE counter to gadlut, not the evil mirror. The Torah's causal chain has kavod bishleimut as the pivotal mediator: brit -> KAVOD -> dibur -> teshuva -> tevunot. This cluster captures the kavod domain itself — the state of complete divine honor through human self-effacement.
